title: 第21章 兽潮平息第22章 与新镇长达成共识
content_zh:
朝阳初升，矿产上的兽潮先一步退去，余老便立马赶回了杨家。
见外边局势已经稳住，便准备去深山寻找家主杨贯峰。
可就在动身的刹那，他忽然心神一荡，顿时神色大变。
“要糟！”
感知到了狐妖的出现，还是在山崖之上，余老一时间心头大乱。
两个孩子还在上面呢，即便有那异石，也绝不是聚气六重妖兽的对手，这下可糟糕了！
他调动灵力速度拉满，几个腾跃间便跃过人群和院落，来到了山崖。
远远望见了两个孩子，他赶紧掏出法盘施展术法，隔空将二人拽到了自己身后。
抬手探查他们的身体，发现两个孩子只是消耗过度身体透支，并没有其他重大伤势后，这才松了口气。
当他转过身，正要施法与狐妖战斗时，却惊讶的发现，对方竟然已经死了！
那股强悍的气息尚未完全散去，表明它是刚刚才被杀死的。
余老上前一看，便瞧见一个指头粗的血洞从狐妖的眉心处贯入，击穿了这妖兽的整个身体，最后从尾部射出。
除此之外狐妖没有任何其他伤势，说明是被一击毙命。
这样明显的灵力冲击手笔，余老自然看得出来。
但他有些不解，俩孩子境界最高的也就二重，如何能将这狐妖一击秒杀的呢？
疑惑间，灵清灵虎二人也走了过来。
“余老祖，这妖兽是异石杀的。”
杨灵清说着，将有些烫手的陈阳递给了余老。
随后她又讲述了之前王烈闯禁地，以及这次兽潮来袭，异石不断放出灵气波动，为他们警戒的事情。
“竟然会有这种事！”

余老也是一脸不可思议，他盯着陈阳思索许久，脑海里浮现出了很久之前，在刚踏入修仙之路时，自己在宗门听过的那些遥远传说。
“此物如此神异，难道真的大有来头？”
经过这一系列的事件，余老愈发觉得陈阳来历不凡，很可能不止是一个稀有异石那么简单。
不过眼下残余兽潮尚存，不是讨论这些的时候。
余老带着两个孩子下了山崖，顺带解决了几只闯入杨家躲藏起来的野兽。
有了余老的加入，前线战局瞬间变为了一边倒。
手中法盘发出耀眼的光彩，余老指尖凌空飞划了几笔，身前一片的野兽便被一股强大重力压成肉饼。
其他野兽见这架势，便也都头脑清醒过来，夹起尾巴就往深山逃。
至此，袭击杨家的兽潮彻底平息。
虽是人员伤亡惨重，大片的屋舍稻田被毁，但终归是扛了下来。
家中的后事交由杨飞云和杨霄雷处理，余老又交代三灵，将所有妖兽尸体带回禁地。
他自己便不再耽搁，越过小松山，去寻找深山杀妖的杨贯峰。
“家主！”
行了半日时间，他发现了负伤归来的杨贯峰。
此时的杨贯峰模样极惨，胸口一道抓伤深可见骨，肩头也被咬下了一大块血肉。
余老赶忙上前，却发现杨贯峰的气息并没有很虚弱，反倒极为深厚。
“这！”
余老一搭手，脸上顿时现出掩饰不住的喜色。
“家主，你突破境界了！”
content_en:
As the morning sun rose, the beast tide on the mine retreated first, and Mr. Yu immediately rushed back to the Yang family.
Seeing that the situation outside had stabilized, he prepared to go to the mountains to find the head of the family, Yang Guanfeng.
But at the moment of setting off, his mind suddenly wandered, and his expression changed drastically.
"It's going to be bad!"
Sensing the appearance of the fox demon, still on the cliff, Mr. Yu was confused for a moment.
The two children are still up there. Even with the strange stone, they are no match for the sixth-level Qi-gathering monster. This is terrible!
He mobilized his spiritual power to reach full speed, and in a few leaps he jumped over the crowds and courtyards and reached the cliff.
Seeing the two children from a distance, he quickly took out the magic disk and cast the spell, dragging the two behind him through the air.
He raised his hand to explore their bodies and found that the two children were only overexhausted and had no other major injuries. He was relieved.
When he turned around and was about to cast a spell to fight the fox demon, he was surprised to find that the opponent was already dead!
The powerful aura has not completely dissipated, indicating that it was killed just now.
When Mr. Yu stepped forward to take a look, he saw a blood hole as thick as a finger penetrated from the center of the fox demon's brow, penetrated the entire body of the monster, and finally shot out from the tail.
Apart from this, the fox demon did not have any other injuries, indicating that it was killed by a single blow.
Mr. Yu can naturally see such obvious spiritual power impact in his handwriting.
But he was a little puzzled. The two children were at the second level at the highest level. How could they kill this fox demon in one blow?
In doubt, Lingqing and Linghu also came over.
"Ancestor Yu, this monster was killed by a strange stone."
Yang Lingqing said, handing the somewhat hot Chen Yang to Mr. Yu.
Then she told about Wang Lie's previous intrusion into the forbidden area, and the attack of the beast tide this time, and the strange stones continued to release spiritual energy fluctuations to warn them.
"How could such a thing happen!"
Mr. Yu also had a look of disbelief on his face. He stared at Chen Yang and thought for a long time, and the distant legends he heard in his sect a long time ago when he first entered the path of cultivating immortals appeared in his mind.
"This thing is so miraculous, does it really have a great origin?"
After this series of events, Mr. Yu increasingly felt that Chen Yang had an extraordinary origin and was probably more than just a rare stone.
However, the remaining beast tide still exists, so this is not the time to discuss this.
Mr. Yu took his two children down the cliff and killed several wild beasts that broke into Yang's house and hid there.
With the addition of Mr. Yu, the battle situation on the front line instantly became one-sided.
The Dharma plate in his hand gave off a dazzling light, Yu Lao made a few strokes with his fingertips, and the beast in front of him was crushed into a meat pie by a strong force of gravity.
Seeing this posture, the other beasts also came to their senses, tucked their tails and fled deep into the mountains.
At this point, the tide of beasts that attacked the Yang family had completely subsided.
Although there were heavy casualties and large areas of houses and rice fields were destroyed, they were finally able to survive.
The funeral affairs of the family were left to Yang Feiyun and Yang Xiaolei to handle. Mr. Yu also asked the three spirits to bring all the monster corpses back to the forbidden land.
He himself stopped delaying and crossed Xiaosong Mountain to look for Yang Guanfeng, who was killing demons in the mountains.
"Master!"
After walking for half a day, he found Yang Guanfeng who had returned from injury.
At this time, Yang Guanfeng looked extremely miserable. A scratch on his chest was so deep that the bones were visible, and a large piece of flesh and blood was bitten off his shoulder.
Mr. Yu hurried forward, only to find that Yang Guanfeng's aura was not weak, but rather very deep.
"This!"
Yu Laoyi put his hands together, and his face suddenly showed a look of joy that could not be concealed.
"Master, you have broken through the realm!"
